label: r3c2
name: Global scale-5 frames, lr 2.5e-3
hypothesis: Change: the r1c1 head (one global 8-frame softmax at scale 5) with lr 2.5e-3. Why: r1c1 matched r1c4 at lr 1.5e-3 and had the highest single seed (0.971). If lr 2.5e-3 helps it as it helped the per-type head, it may beat 0.969. Refuted if the mean is at or below 0.969, or a seed collapses, which would show the scale-5 global mixture is less robust at high lr.
